recipes.name: Campbell’s Tater Tot Casserole
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.5 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup (Regular or 98% Fat Free)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Heat a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef and onion in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.
Stir condensed soup, ketchup, and Worcestershire into the skillet. Spoon beef mixture into a 12x8-inch shallow baking dish. Arrange tater tots around the edge of casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven until tater tots are cooked through, about 25 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Campbell’s Tater Tot Casserole
raw_recipe.description: Campbell’s tater tot casserole is an oven-baked cast iron skillet meal made with ground beef and condensed soup for an easy weeknight meal kids love.

review.reviewBody: I love tater tot casserole, this recipe is much the same as mine, but I don't add ketchup. I also add a drained can of corn and a drained can of green beans for extra nutrition, and a 1/2 cup of milk mixed in to loosen it up and stretch the soup. MMMM MMMM Good!

I added two cans cream of mushroom soup, two tb worcestershire sauce, did add ketchup, one can green beans, 1/2 cup frozen corn. cooked all in cast iron skillet and then baked with tator tots on top. add shredded cheese last 5 min.

So I used this recipe but wanted to share my own alternative method as we have an allergy to onion in our house. So I use all the same indoors ingredients but the onion and the mushroom soup as most canned soup has onion in it I have had to learn to make a lot of things from scratch. So what I do is dice mushrooms and cook the mushroom in 4 tbs of butter on the stove. Add a beef bullion cube. Then Brown the hamburger in the same pot. After the meat is brown i use 3tbs of flour and cook it into the meat for about 3 minutes to cook starch out and then add 2 cups of mlk slowly and bring to a boil once thickened I add frozen mixed veggies, worchshire and ketchup. Then put together the casserole my boyfriend basically eats the whole pan to himself over the course of a couple of days

This is a really good base for tater tot casserole I just added my own seasonings (salt, pepper, parsley) to a mixture of sauteed onion and garlic, and beef. I then added the ketchup and Worcestershire sauce, stirred, added the soup (cream of mushroom with garlic), cooked it another minute, spread in pan and layered with the tater tots, cooked 25 min in preheated 425 degree oven, added shredded cheddar, returned to oven and cooked for min to melt cheese, hit broil- 3 more minutes. I had to use a 9x13 pan so it was a little flat but tasted amazing! Very filling, fast, easy, adjust the servings and feed a crowd. If you need a lot of flavor to your food I don't suggest leaving out or cutting down on any of the ingredients or seasonings (except garlic if you're not a big fan). I'm a garlic lover so this was just how I liked it.

I rarely ever write reviews anymore, but I had to for this one because you really need to make changes in order for it to have any semblance of taste, sorry to say.... but with the changes others have mentioned, it is actually quite good! I used Cream of Chicken soup because that is what I had on hand, added a can of drained french cut green beans, and a can of drained corn, and then followed the recipe up until adding the ketchup and worcestchire sauce... I added both according to the recipe, tasted it, and then realized I needed to double it because the taste was so bland. Then I realized it needed something more, so I followed another reviewer and added 4 oz of cream cheese (cut up & melted into the ground beef) and a small container of sour cream (thank goodness I had both on hand!!), some salt and pepper, and then BOOM! It tasted so much better. I sprinkled an 8 oz bag of shredded cheddar cheese underneath the tots, and then covered the top full of tots... I baked for 35 mins to get the tots nice & crunchy, and then added green onions after taking out of the oven. I brought it to a New Year's Eve get-together, and the guests wanted to take all the leftovers home with them!! So with changes, this is a very nice recipe, very simple to do, and very filling as well.

We love this. We usually triple the recipe and make in a 11x14 glass pan. We also don't add ketchup.We also add 3 cans of soup when tripling the recipe,plus 1/4 c milk and 2 T of Worcestershire sauce to the soup mixture and 8 oz of sour cream then mix together. We add 1/4 c dried minced onion and 2t of garlic powder to the hamburger when it is cooking. We then mix the soup and hamburger add a thin layer of cheese ( 1/2 c) then add about 1 1/2 lbs of frozen tater tots and add a layer of shredded cheese (1 c) to the top and bake at 425 degrees for 30-45 minutes.
Added green beans and corn as base. Added garlic to onion and sweet italian sausage instead of hamburger. Added shredded cheese after cooking. Then return to oven just long enough to melt cheese.

This is one of my husband’s favorite dishes!!! He’s vegetarian so we use the zesty Italian meatless meatballs and the Morningstar grillers crumbles; we add red, yellow, and green bell peppers to the onion mix. My mom used cream of mushroom but I like cream of potato better we mix it up with some soy milk, vegetable broth, mixed vegetables and whatever seasonings you like. We put half of the tot on the bottom of the pan and the other half on top cause why not. Sometimes we use different cheese blends to top it off but there’s almost always some jiffy cornbread on the side!

After reading what others wrote, I decided that I needed to make some changes to spice up this recipe to my liking. I only used 1/2 of a red onion and cooked it with a little garlic, salt & pepper. I decided to omit the Worteshire sauce and ketchup altogether. I did use the can of cream of mushroom soup, and I added a can of creamed corn and a small can of diced green chilies. It still tasted bland to me so I decided to spice it up even more with black pepper, celery salt, paprika and red pepper flakes- to taste. To finish, I melted a little chedder cheese on top at the last minute of cooking.

My fiance loved it! He said he could eat the whole pan. I think it was very easy to make, delicious and super filling! A great weeknight meal.
Very fast easy and very good!!! Added sour cream and an extra half can of cream of mushroom... put my tator tots im oven for 10 minutes while meat was cooking.... soooooo good! Will do again!!!
Simple and good. Tonight I made it with water chestnuts and a can of French cut green beans to make a 1 pot meal. Thinned it with a little milk. Husband loved the additions!
What a home run. I double the ingredients except for the tatertots. We love this for weeknight meals and I take it on the road with me in my semi truck. Great reheated.
I added some Kinder's Woodfired garlic spice to the meet. It was ok. I might try it again with different seasonings.
I broiled the top of tater tots to crisp them up. Turned out great!

Turned out very good! I added garlic, salt and pepper when cooking the meat (I substituted ground turkey). Before topping with the tator tots, I sprinkled with cheddar cheese. I sprinkled more salt on top of the tator tots. 25 minutes cooked it perfect!
Interesting. I’m not really sure what to think about this. Little dry maybe because of the cast iron. gonna finish it but I don’t think I’ll make it again.
Absolutely yummy. Just like my grandma used to make and I absolutely love it so do my kids
Great recipe! I make this all the time!
So yummy… better than what I remember my mm making
I added sour cream and red peppers!
